text:
Jin Park: Quick note — noticed docs still show embeddings example with "input": "..." in a few places. Users are confused when they try to batch.
Nina Alvarez: Where exactly? I can grep the repo.
Jin Park: Found in docs/openapi/embeddings.yml and snippets/python/embeds_quickstart.py, plus a curl example in guides/usage.md.
Omar Siddiqui: Our API accepts both shapes but canonical is inputs array. We should make examples consistent and add a short compatibility note.
Jin Park: Proposed openapi example:
```json
{ "model": "rwd-embed-1", "inputs": ["first text", "second text"] }
```
Nina Alvarez: I'll update the python and curl snippets to use inputs[]. Also add a one-line migration paragraph under Embeddings -> Request shape.
ci-bot: PR #905 lint: openapi examples must match schema (example currently object vs expected array).
docs-bot: Deploy preview blocked until schema mismatch is fixed.
Nina Alvarez: Pushed PR with fixes for openapi + python + guides. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/905/files
Omar Siddiqui: Reviewed and added a tiny note in SDK changelog referencing the migration blurb.
ci-bot: CI passed and PR #905 merged.
Jin Park: Thanks — everything looks good. I'll follow up to sweep JS/Go snippets later today.
